description: Read the household's meal events (guests, eating out, packed lunches) between two dates.

cursor.description: The `nextCursor` of the page before; omit for the first page.

from.description: First day to read, ISO date; defaults to today.

to.description: Last day to read, ISO date; defaults to 30 days after 'from'. At most 92 days after it.
